name: plugin-eval
description: Three-layer quality evaluation framework for OpenCode plugins
author: jarbcs1

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Evaluate a plugin or skill for quality

agents.name: eval-orchestrator
agents.description: Orchestrates plugin quality evaluation. Use PROACTIVELY when evaluating, scoring or certifying plugin quality.

agents.name: eval-judge
agents.description: LLM judge for plugin quality assessment. Scores skills on triggering accuracy, orchestration fitness, output quality and scope calibration using anchored rubrics.

skills.name: evaluation-methodology
skills.description: PluginEval quality methodology — dimensions, rubrics, statistical methods and scoring formulas. Use this skill when understanding how plugin quality is measured, when interpreting a low score on a specific dimension, when deciding how to improve a skill's triggering accuracy or orchestration fitness, when calibrating scoring thresholds for your marketplace or when explaining quality badges to external partners.
